additional_info.subject: ID0411560-DC/Si-D/QA-[MP / N7 160345959] Charging not possible CRM:00642002155
additional_info.body:
Hello Basheer,
Hope you are doing great.
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Q Auto LLC
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / N7 160345959
Charger ID/Serial No.:
O9ImPH
Problem Description:
Charging not possible
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 07/07/2023, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
From the logs, we found abnormalities with the pre-charge voltage not reaching the target voltage. We suspect this is due to the power converter or the DC fuse.
After analyzing the last four weeks, we identified an error with the DC fuse. Therefore, we need to check fuse FC9. If it is found to be faulty, it needs to be replaced. Please find below attached MLFB for your reference.
3NB1128-4KK11
I have added the analysis to the case timeline for your reference.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
